newsitem.title: UK: Moody's cuts Kirin International l-term to Aa3.
newsitem.headline: Moody's cuts Kirin International l-term to Aa3.

text.p: Rating agency Moody's said on Tuesday it had cut Kirin International Finance (Netherlands) BV long-term debt rating to Aa3 from Aa1.
The agency said Kirin International Finance was a wholly-owned subsidiary of Kirin Brewery Company Ltd (Kirin).

"The debt affected are the company's $500 million Euro Medium Term Note programme and 10 billion yen senior unsecured Euro notes due November 2000 issued under a keepwell agreement with Kirin," Moody's said in a statement.
"The rating action is based on the expectation that it will be difficult for Kirin to preserve and recover its beer market in Japan."
